why_best: Seamlessly melting one key term into another visually reinforces the platform's ability to effortlessly synthesize complex, shifting information into a single unified stream.
why_bad: A sudden slide or hard jump cut between terms would feel disjointed and cheapen the dashboard's modern, high-touch data narrative.
trap: Over-softening the shapes during the shift will make the typography unreadable, muddying the corporate messaging into unrecognizable blobs.
